short.zh: 聪明的捷径不总是对的

t.zh: 新的一章：装背包。出门旅行，背包有重量上限。每件东西有重量和价值，每件最多带一个。怎么装，带上的价值最大？
t.en: A new chapter: packing a backpack. You are off on a trip, and the backpack has a weight limit. Each thing has a weight and a value, and you can take at most one of each. How do you pack to carry the most value?

t.zh: 人们常用两种「捷径」：最贵的先放，或者最划算的先放（每千克的价值最高）。按顺序挨个看，装得下就装。这种每一步都挑眼前最好的做法，叫作。
t.en: People often use one of two “shortcuts”: priciest first, or best value first (the highest value per kilogram). Go through the items in that order and pack each one that fits. Always grabbing what looks best right now is called being .

t.zh: 这一关有两道题。规则面板里有两个「自动装包」按钮，分别按这两种捷径装包。先试试它们，再自己动手，装出目标价值。
t.en: This level has two puzzles. The side panel has two “Auto-pack” buttons, one for each shortcut. Try them first, then pack by hand to reach the target value.

goal.zh: 物品总重量不能超过背包上限，每件最多带一个。两道题里，都装出目标价值。
goal.en: The total weight can’t exceed the backpack’s limit, and you can take at most one of each item. Reach the target value in both puzzles.

how.zh: 点物品放进或拿出背包。规则面板里的两个按钮会按捷径自动装包，可以试试它们。
how.en: Click items to put them in or take them out. The two buttons in the side panel auto-pack using the shortcuts; give them a try.

body.zh: 第 1 题里，「最贵的先放」差了一点；第 2 题里，「最划算的先放」也差了一点。看起来很聪明的贪心规则，总有例外。
body.en: In puzzle 1, “priciest first” fell just short; in puzzle 2, “best value first” fell just short too. Greedy rules that look clever always have exceptions.

body.zh: 最保险的办法是把所有装法都试一遍。5 件物品有 32 种装法，还试得过来；30 件物品就有 10 亿多种。
body.en: The safe way is to try every possible packing. 5 items give 32 packings, which is still manageable; 30 items give over a billion.

note.zh: 贪心（每一步挑眼前最好的）不一定得到最好的结果。
note.en: Greedy (always picking what looks best right now) doesn’t necessarily give the best result.
